problem.title: Find Smallest Sum of Contiguous Subarray of Size K
problem.problemStatement: Write a program that finds the minimum sum of any contiguous subarray of size exactly K.
problem.input: First line contains N and K. Second line contains N integers.
problem.output: The minimum sum of size K.
